subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Garantee'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The erroneous spelling is **'Garantee'.**
 
• The correct spelling of this erroneous word is **'Guarantee'.**
 
• The meaning of the word **'Guarantee'** is a firm promise that something will be done or that something will happen.
 
 
• ***Example:*** *Money doesn't **guarantee** a happy life.*
 
 
 
• From the given meaning and example, it is clear the marked option,'Garantee' is the erroneous spelling of Guarantee
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2.**
